experiment: V69-T2: symmetry-averaged training, extended scale/LR for M, scaled schedule for A, vs the shallow baselines
precision: CUDA backend: f32 storage/accumulation, matmul inputs possibly TF32; NOT strict FP32. Baselines are host-side f64.

partitions.train: 6000 per family x budget x class cell (72000), nested subsets rank<k for k in {2000,6000}
partitions.test: 512 per cell (6144), sealed until final evaluation

data.exclusion: identity-level (full 65-byte canonical keys) against gen-001, the G1 pool and the T1 contributing pool
data.partitioning: root-level keyed hash 80/10/10; taken-set over canonical child keys alone; groups = per-partition connected components of contributing roots

training.schedule: linear warmup 200 updates to peak lr, cosine decay to 0.1*peak at the final update

modes.d8: per-sample keyed-random board symmetry; stream t2_aug
modes.sym: M only: BCE of the mean logit over all 8 board symmetries of each example; registered inference = same 8-view mean logit

selection: A*: best A; M*: best M of any mode; P*: best M with mode d8; each lowest FINAL-update validation BCE (ties: higher balanced accuracy); validation only

final.controls: derangement and erasure; neural candidates also report 8-fold symmetry TTA logits (report-only)
